description: FD-29 minimal capability baseline for the main window. Grants only event emission/listening, webview default APIs, the four narrow core:window permissions the custom titlebar's window-caption buttons need over decorations:false (allow-minimize, allow-toggle-maximize, allow-close, allow-start-dragging; F-901, v0.4.0 Phase 1), and - added in v0.4.0 Phase 2 (F-909) - the single dialog:allow-open permission for the OS folder picker. dialog:allow-open is the ONE capability this release's security-sensitive phase adds; it is the folder-selection-only subset of the dialog plugin (NOT dialog:default, which also grants allow-message and allow-save). It lets the user pick the library root; the picked path is handed to the backend via settings_set, which owns all subsequent filesystem access. Deliberately still NOT core:window:default (much broader than this window calls), NO fs, and NO shell. The frontend never touches the filesystem directly (architecture Section 5).
